entry.hover_demand_source: median native collective demand over preceding 3 s of stable position hold, separately for each stack
entry.failed_calibration_action: mark not calibrated; do not run steps or tune acceptance limits

thrust_step.velocity_comparison: mean final 0.1 s minus mean preceding 0.2 s
thrust_step.record: commanded demand, native accepted GUA/PX4 setpoint, actual motor outputs and truth up velocity; no equal acceleration claim

recovery_after_each_step.command: existing full position+yaw path at pre-step anchor, not zero thrust

abort_envelope.action: stop attitude stream and invoke existing hold/land failure path; fail the run

required_prerequisites: main RUN RELEASE and exclusive flight resources
separate source/build and ardupilot_msgs overlay identities verified
GUID_OPTIONS bit 3 explicitly set in candidate parameters and read back; preserve every other bit
GUID_TIMEOUT 3.0 read back; no mode/timeout parameter changes hidden in adapters
record AP ATC angle boost, throttle filtering, motor thrust mapping/hover-learning settings and PX4 hover/thrust-model parameters with model mass/rotor/battery identity
default-closed, finite/non-unit, wrong frame, stale/future native input, CDR and existing PV/mixed/position/velocity regressions pass
freeze exact calibration value in per-run record before attitude/thrust steps
